      • applicationType

        @NameInMap(value="ApplicationType")
public String applicationType

        The application type code. For example, PC_WebSite indicates a PC website.

        example:

        PC_WebSite

      • applicationTypeText

        @NameInMap(value="ApplicationTypeText")
public String applicationTypeText

        The display name of the application type.

        example:

        PC website

      • bizId

        @NameInMap(value="BizId")
public String bizId

        The business identifier of the application instance.

        example:

        WS_SITE_1

      • caseAuditStatus

        @NameInMap(value="CaseAuditStatus")
public String caseAuditStatus

        The audit status.

        example:

        1

      • caseShelfStatus

        @NameInMap(value="CaseShelfStatus")
public String caseShelfStatus

        The listing status.

        example:

        online

      • chatbiTaskId

        @NameInMap(value="ChatbiTaskId")
public String chatbiTaskId

        The ID of the ChatBI BuildSchemaIndex asynchronous task.

        example:

        task-1

      • chatbiTaskStatus

        @NameInMap(value="ChatbiTaskStatus")
public String chatbiTaskStatus

        The status of the ChatBI BuildSchemaIndex task. Valid values: running, finish, and failed.

        example:

        finish

      • commodityCode

        @NameInMap(value="CommodityCode")
public String commodityCode

        The commodity code of the order.

        example:

        domain_website_public_cn

      • customerService

        @NameInMap(value="CustomerService")
public String customerService

        The contact information or instructions for customer service.

        example:

        support@example.com

      • deployArea

        @NameInMap(value="DeployArea")
public String deployArea

        The code of the region where the application is deployed.

        example:

        HongKong

      • icpbaNo

        @NameInMap(value="IcpbaNo")
public String icpbaNo

        The ICP filing number of the bound custom domain name. Separate multiple ICP filing numbers with commas (,).

        example:

        京ICP备12345678号-1

        @NameInMap(value="IndependentDeployment")
public AppInstanceProfile.AppInstanceProfileIndependentDeployment independentDeployment

        The independent server information. This information is computed in real time by DescribeAppInstance and is not populated in list operations.

        @NameInMap(value="InstanceId")

        @NameInMap(value="OpenChatBi")
public Boolean openChatBi

        Specifies whether the current user is included in the grayscale whitelist for the ChatBI feature.

        @NameInMap(value="OrdTime")

        @NameInMap(value="OrderId")

        @NameInMap(value="PreviewUrl")
public String previewUrl

        @NameInMap(value="SeoSite")
public String seoSite

        The configuration identifier of the SEO site.

        example:

      • shareRenderWatermark

        @NameInMap(value="ShareRenderWatermark")
public String shareRenderWatermark

        Specifies whether to enable the watermark for shared rendering. A value of 1 indicates that the feature is enabled, and a value of 0 indicates that the feature is disabled. If this parameter is not configured, it is left empty.

        example:

        1

      • siteVersion

        @NameInMap(value="SiteVersion")
public String siteVersion

        The site version code.

        example:

        Max_Edition

      • siteVersionText

        @NameInMap(value="SiteVersionText")
public String siteVersionText

        The display name of the site version, which includes the deployment region.

        example:

        Ultimate Edition [Hong Kong]

      • source

        @NameInMap(value="Source")
public String source

        The identifier of the creation or synchronization source.

        example:

        MARKET_CLOUD_DREAM

      • templateEtag

        @NameInMap(value="TemplateEtag")
public String templateEtag

        The ETag identifier of the current application template.

        example:

        etag-1

      • templateId

        @NameInMap(value="TemplateId")
public String templateId

        The ID of the template used by the current application.

        example:

        tpl-1

      • upgradeStatus

        @NameInMap(value="UpgradeStatus")
public String upgradeStatus

        The upgrade status of the instance. DOING indicates that the upgrade is in progress, SUCC indicates that the upgrade is successful, and FAIL indicates that the upgrade failed.

        example:

        SUCC
